claims.head: The Predators want O'Reilly head to head with Tuch
claims.call: The Predators’ L1 (Stamkos, O'Reilly and Bourque) spends at least 61% of its 5-on-5 time against the Capitals’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Predators keep sending O'Reilly’s line (Stamkos, O'Reilly and Bourque) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Andrew Brunette has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Capitals’ first line is Tuch, Strome and Kyrou.

NSH.head: The Predators start a half-step ahead
NSH.body: Washington is on the second night of a back-to-back, while Nashville has home-ice advantage. Washington has been out-chancing opponents lately, though. The Capitals can still swing it if they get good looks.
